home.aboutTitle: A community of developers and AI enthusiasts in Shanghai and nearby cities.
home.aboutDescription: Join SpaceX AI Shanghai to share knowledge, join events, and shape the future of AI with developers and AI enthusiasts who love technology and innovation.

partners.heading: Shanghai's AI creator ecosystem is something we build together.
partners.description: SpaceX AI Shanghai is an open community of builders. We welcome other communities, venues, brands, and universities to get involved—co-hosting an event, providing a space, creating content together, or lending support. When we each bring what we do best, the builders here can go further.

contact.sentence: Events, talks, or joining the group — just reach out.
